evidence.source_name: ArtsPark at Young Circle — official source
supports: ArtsPark at Young Circle is a 10-acre circle at US 1 and Hollywood Boulevard in downtown Hollywood.
The ArtsPark Amphitheater features a 60 by 40 foot main stage and lawn seating for 2,500 guests.
Park features include a playground, splash pad, amphitheater, glass blowing, lighted walking path and restrooms.
ArtsPark hours are 7 a.m. to 11 p.m. daily.

editorial.hook: 10-acre downtown circle with a playground, splash pad and amphitheater
editorial.why_here: ArtsPark at Young Circle is a 10-acre circle in downtown Hollywood with a playground, splash pad and the ArtsPark Amphitheater. Park features also include glass blowing, a lighted walking path and restrooms.
editorial.know_before: ArtsPark hours are 7 a.m. to 11 p.m. daily.

supports: Islamorada Fish Company Restaurant is at Bass Pro Shops in Dania Beach.
The Dania restaurant offers outdoor dining over a lake or indoor dining among fish mounts and an aquarium.

Bass Pro Shops is at 200 Gulf Stream Way, Dania, Florida 33004.
